subject.title: [Feature]: Move away from useMultiFileAuthState for Baileys

question: Should the bundled WhatsApp plugin adopt a canonical SQLite auth store now, and if so what migration, recovery, and re-pairing contract should existing linked sessions receive?
rationale: The work changes sensitive persisted session state and may require a SQLite schema/lifecycle decision; source review cannot safely choose the user-upgrade and recovery contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor SQLite migration
options.body: Approve a plugin-owned SQLite store with a doctor-owned one-time migration and explicit upgrade/recovery acceptance criteria.

options.title: Retain hardened file storage
options.body: Keep the current multi-file model plus targeted corruption and performance hardening until a complete migration design is sponsored.

options.title: Defer to a broader WhatsApp storage plan
options.body: Pause implementation until WhatsApp state ownership, schema lifecycle, and operational support are decided together.

recommendation.title: Sponsor SQLite migration
recommendation.body: Approve a plugin-owned SQLite store with a doctor-owned one-time migration and explicit upgrade/recovery acceptance criteria.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent auth persistence and recovery changes make mcaxtr the strongest evidence-backed routing candidate for the storage and migration contract.
